subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SCR4
title: Requires that a committee of the Legislative Assembly may adopt an amendment to a legislative measure only if the chief sponsor of the measure approves the amendment prior to amendment adoption by the committee.
headline: SCR 4 did not pass

claims.text: SCR 4 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SCR 4 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
